import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 16843009;
    static int[][] capacity = new int[400][400];
    static int[] mark = new int[400];
    static int stamp = 3;
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] lab;
    static char[][] req;
    static int[] dirx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] diry = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static int node_id(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
    }

    static void expand(int[][] reach, int[][] treach, int val) {
        // copy reach to treach
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int ni = i + dirx[d];
                        int nj = j + diry[d];
                        if (ni > 0 && ni <= n && nj > 0 && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && lab[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reach[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        int[][] reach = new int[15][15];
        int[][] treach = new int[15][15];
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        for (int it = 0; it < 100; it++) {
            expand(reach, treach, 1);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            expand(reach, treach, 2);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int augment(int u, int sink, int bneck) {
        if (u == sink) return bneck;
        if (mark[u] == stamp) return 0;
        mark[u] = stamp;
        for (int v = sink; v >= 0; v--) {
            if (capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                int got = augment(v, sink, Math.min(bneck, capacity[u][v]));
                if (got > 0) {
                    capacity[u][v] -= got;
                    capacity[v][u] += got;
                    return got;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        lab = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        req = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        int infx = 0, infy = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                lab[i][j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (lab[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                req[i][j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        int[][][][] dist = new int[15][15][15][15];
        // Initialize dist with INF
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 15; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i][j][k], INF);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dirx[d];
                    int nj = j + diry[d];
                    if (ni > 0 && ni <= n && nj > 0 && nj <= n && lab[i][j] != 'Y' && lab[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        dist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall
        for (int kx = 1; kx <= n; kx++) {
            for (int ky = 1; ky <= n; ky++) {
                for (int sx = 1; sx <= n; sx++) {
                    for (int sy = 1; sy <= n; sy++) {
                        for (int tx = 1; tx <= n; tx++) {
                            for (int ty = 1; ty <= n; ty++) {
                                dist[sx][sy][tx][ty] = Math.min(dist[sx][sy][tx][ty],
                                        dist[sx][sy][kx][ky] + dist[kx][ky][tx][ty]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n + 1;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 2;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(lab[i][j])) {
                    capacity[src][node_id(i, j)] = lab[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(req[i][j])) {
                    capacity[n * n + node_id(i, j)][sink] = req[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(lab[i][j]) && lab[i][j] > '0') {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) {
                        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(req[a][b]) && req[a][b] > '0' &&
                                dist[i][j][a][b] <= t && canreach(i, j, a, b, infx, infy)) {
                                capacity[node_id(i, j)][n * n + node_id(a, b)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0;
        int add;
        while ((add = augment(src, sink, 1000)) > 0) {
            flow += add;
            stamp++;
        }
        System.out.println(flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
